Rolling features use only outcomes known on the trade date (settle date strictly before the trade date). If a distinctness check fails, change the generator, not the feature definitions.

sources.title: Settlement Failure Prediction Workflow: Custom AI Implementation
sources.snippet: Implement a custom AI agentic workflow to predict and resolve trade settlement failures. Our architecture reduces fails, lowers costs, and automates middle-office operations for quant funds.

sources.title: Predictive Settlement Fail Prevention Explained
sources.snippet: The Blockchain Fix: A Predictive Settlement Fail Prevention framework, powered by a shared, immutable ledger, fundamentally shifts the paradigm from reactive to proactive. By anchoring real-time transaction data and counterparty activity to a single source of truth, machine learning models can continuously analyze settlement flows.
